approved.en: Ukraine has resumed missile strikes on Russian oil refineries and a missile-maintenance base, supported by additional Storm Shadow missiles supplied by the United Kingdom. Russian drones have attacked ships in the Black Sea near Romania, leaving seven crew members missing, and have disrupted health supply shipments in Ukraine. Kyiv blames SpaceX for throttling Starlink terminals that support its drone operations, while Russia has detained a Japanese journalist on espionage charges. The conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Russiske droner har angrepet skip i Svartehavet nær Romania, og syv besetningsmedlemmer er savnet, og har forstyrret leveranser av helsesuppler i Ukraina. Kyiv anklager SpaceX for å dempe Starlink-terminaler som støtter deres dronoperasjoner, mens Russland har fengslet en japansk journalist på spionasjebeskyldning. Konflikten forårsaket 75 767 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Hezbollah explosives seized in two Lebanese trucks have prompted Lebanon's prime minister and security forces to promise a thorough investigation, while Israeli artillery and air strikes continue against Hezbollah positions in southern Lebanon, causing civilian casualties. In northern Israel, a Hezbollah submunition exploded in a teenager's backpack during a hike near the Lebanon border, killing Elazar Yair Wilensky and wounding dozens, leading the IDF chief to order a probe and authorities to consider restricting hikes. Students on the same hike fashioned tourniquets from belts and socks after the blast. Hezbollah announced compensation for Lebanese homeowners whose houses were destroyed and unveiled an aid plan for displaced civilians. The UCDP recorded 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024.

I Nord-Israel eksploderte en Hezbollah-submunisjon i en tenårings ryggsekk under en fottur nær Libanongränsen, og drepte Elazar Yair Wilensky og såret dusinvis, noe som fikk IDF-sjefen til å beordre en undersøkelse og myndighetene til å vurdere restriksjoner på fotturer. Studenter på samme tur laget tourniquetter av belter og sokker etter eksplosjonen. Hezbollah kunngjorde erstatning til libanesiske huseiere hvis hus ble ødelagt og presenterte en hjelpsplan for fortrengte sivile. UCDP registrerte 4 335 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024.

Iran has increased its air defenses while shipping LPG and jet fuel despite a US blockade, and has sunk two container ships near the Strait of Hormuz, expanding the threat to regional shipping. US officials are reportedly considering the use of the "mother of all bombs" if fighting resumes, and Trump has ruled out using a nuclear bomb on Iran. The conflict recorded 123 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Amerikanske tjenestemenn vurderer ifølge rapporter å bruke «the mother of all bombs» dersom kampene gjenopptas, og Trump har avvist å bruke en atomvåpen mot Iran. approved.en: Syrian authorities arrested the suspect known as the "Butcher of Baniyas" for the 2013 coastal massacres and sentenced two individuals to death for the 2025 coastal sectarian violence. Two Syrian pipelines were damaged in attacks on energy infrastructure, and a gas export pipeline in northeastern Syria was hit, causing a fire. Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu disclosed a direct conversation with President Ahmed al-Sharaa following a 2025 strike in Damascus. Syrian sources said the discussion involved U.S. and Arab mediation. The conflict produced 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

To syriske rørledninger ble skadet i angrep på energiinfrastruktur, og en gasseksportledning i nordøst-Syria ble truffet, noe som førte til brann. Israels statsminister Netanyahu opplyste om en direkte samtale med president Ahmed al-Sharaa etter et angrep i Damaskus i 2025. Syriske kilder sa at diskusjonen omhandlet amerikansk og arabisk mekling. Konflikten førte til 2 732 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

Militias are adjusting to a new era, and an Iraqi group publicly backed the Houthis as Saudi tensions rise. The foreign minister reiterated that Iraq does not seek war and supports paths to peace, and Morocco and Iraq signed an agreement to strengthen security training cooperation. 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Communal clashes have intensified in Lakes state, prompting a curfew and a visit by caretaker governor Rin Tueny, while UNMISS has expanded civilian protection after deadly attacks in Rumbek. SPLA-IO forces retook Akobo following a dawn clash that left many dead and wounded, and SSPDF soldiers were wounded in an assault on a Mundri West military outpost. The U.S. Embassy condemned an assault on WFP workers in Jonglei that involved looting of aid, and an AIC cleric was shot dead in Juba. A Juba High Court sentenced five officers to 24 years for raiding a general's home. The lethal communal violence now far exceeds the 2 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Kommunale sammenstøt har økt i Lakes delstat, noe som har ført til nattforbud og et besøk av vikar guvernør Rin Tueny, mens UNMISS har utvidet sivilt beskyttelsesarbeid etter dødelige angrep i Rumbek. SPLA-IO styrkene tok tilbake Akobo etter et morgenkollisjon som etterlot mange døde og sårede, og SSPDF soldater ble såret i et angrep på en militær utkikkspost i Mundri West. Den amerikanske ambassaden fordømte et angrep på WFP arbeidere i Jonglei som innebar plyndring av hjelp, og en AIC prest ble skutt død i Juba. En høyesterett i Juba dømte fem offiserer til 24 år for å ha ransaket en generals hjem. Den dødelige kommunale volden overstiger nå langt de 2 kamprelaterte dødsfallene i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Ethiopian forces have seized a key town in Tigray that includes the regional airport and are moving toward an Eritrean border town, while fighting in Amhara has left at least 183 dead, according to the UN. Militia reports say Eritrean forces suffered losses as Ethiopian troops expand control in Tigray. The United States is urging Ethiopia and Eritrea to de-escalate, and the Ethiopian Red Cross condemned an attack that killed an ambulance driver in Benishangul-Gumuz. Hospitals in Tigray have resumed operations as supplies arrive, and the conflict caused 2,824 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Militsrapporter sier at eritreiske styrker led tap mens etiopiske tropper utvider kontrollen i Tigray. USA oppfordrer Etiopia og Eritrea til å de-eskalere, og den etiopiske Røde Kors fordømte et angrep som drepte en ambulansefører i Benishangul-Gumuz. Sykehus i Tigray har gjenopptatt driften etter at forsyninger ankommer, og konflikten forårsaket 2 824 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Fitgharin forces are consolidating control of the Mogadishu-Baidoa corridor while Laftagareen forces have captured Buurhakaba after heavy fighting in the Bay region, and other fighters loyal to a former regional president have also seized Burhakaba. The Somali government is screening travelers after Kenya confirmed an imported Ebola case and is hosting regional talks in Egypt with Eritrea, Sudan and its own officials to coordinate security amid rising Ethiopia-Eritrea tensions. The federal government is deepening defence ties with Pakistan, seeking JF‑17 fighter jets and securing the release of four Pakistani sailors freed from Somali pirates. Somalia has set dates for parliamentary and presidential polls, with a presidential election scheduled for May 2027. The conflict caused 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Den somaliske regjeringen screener reisende etter at Kenya bekreftet et importert ebolatilfelle, og den arrangerer regionale samtaler i Egypt med Eritrea, Sudan og egne tjenestemenn for å koordinere sikkerheten i lys av økende spenninger mellom Etiopia og Eritrea. Den føderale regjeringen utdyper forsvarssamarbeidet med Pakistan, søker JF‑17‑jagerfly og sikrer løslatelsen av fire pakistanske sjømenn som ble frigjort fra somaliske pirater. Somalia har satt datoer for parlamentariske og presidentvalg, med et presidentvalg planlagt til mai 2027. Konflikten forårsaket 2 284 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Gunmen attacked an immigration patrol in Niger State, killing one officer and wounding another, and also burned the officer's body. Bandits carried out a separate assault in Borgu LGA, while a Christian humanitarian worker was slain in northwest Nigeria and a Niger lawyer was jailed for a social-media post about the army. The United States added Nigeria to its blacklist for recruiting child soldiers, and Mali expanded its reserve force by 2,400 recruits, including 800 women. These incidents show a widening of violence beyond isolated attacks on security forces to include civilian targets and legal repression. The conflict produced 4,159 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
